skill_outcomes.skill_name: Apply theoretical knowledge to solve real-world problems in businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems in business environments.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of current solutions in businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of existing solutions in businesses, identify challenges, and propose appropriate improvements.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluate the sustainability and scalability of solutions based on factors like cost, efficiency, and impact on the business environment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will assess the sustainability and scalability of solutions considering various factors such as cost, efficiency, and impact on the business environment.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Install and configure basic software and hardware systems according to guidelines or models implemented in businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will install and configure basic software and hardware systems following guidelines or models used in businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Use IT tools and software to perform specific tasks, install business software, and check basic functions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will use IT tools and software to perform specific tasks, install business software, and verify basic functionalities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Adjust system configurations based on specific requirements or update installations according to standardized procedures of businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will adjust system configurations based on specific requirements or update installations according to standardized procedures of businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Ask and answer questions posed by instructors and businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will ask and answer questions posed by instructors and businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Participate in group discussions to solve problems presented by instructors or businesses, defend personal opinions before groups
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will participate in group discussions to solve problems presented by instructors or businesses and defend their personal opinions in front of groups.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Complete projects assigned by instructors or businesses, coordinate with team members to complete tasks
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will complete projects assigned by instructors or businesses and coordinate with team members to accomplish tasks.
